challenges.title: 12-Hour Shifts, Friday Rest and Inspections

items.title: 12-Hour Shifts Push Art. 101 to the Limit
items.text: Typical 12-hour guard shifts (حراس الأمن) use up the statutory 12-hour presence limit per day in full — every minute beyond that is unlawful and is checked by labor inspectors.

items.title: Observing the Friday Rest Day Correctly
items.text: The weekly rest day (standard Friday, Art. 104) must last at least 24 consecutive hours, be fully paid, and may not be replaced with a cash payment.

items.title: Compensating Holiday/Rest-Day Work Correctly
items.text: Work on the weekly rest day must be paid as overtime with a 50% premium (effectively 150%), or offset with a paid substitute day (Art. 107).

solutions.title: How Klacks Takes the Load Off Security Services in Saudi Arabia
solutions.subtitle: From covered posts to a hard 12-hour limit — it all fits together.

items.title: Sites & Posts, Gap-Free
items.text: Every post across all sites — Klacks flags every open slot instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: 12-Hour Limit Monitored Live (Art. 101)
items.text: Klacks monitors shift sequences live and warns immediately if a guard would exceed the configured 12-hour daily limit. On request, Klacks hard-blocks a breach in automatic planning; with manual planning it stays at a warning.

items.title: Friday Rest Checked as a Rule
items.text: If the weekly rest day of at least 24 consecutive hours is stored as a rule, Klacks takes it into account when planning and warns about violations — the documentation provides the basis for proving full payment through your payroll system.

items.title: Rest-Day Work as a Time Premium
items.text: Work on the rest day can be stored with the 50% premium as a time credit; your payroll system calculates the money amount. The paid substitute day (Art. 107) is covered by the optional compensatory rest.

items.title: Patrols Optimised
items.text: For mobile services, Klacks lays out patrol routes so distances stay short and intervals are kept.

items.title: Installed on Your Premises: Deployment Data Stays in KSA
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure. Sensitive deployment and personnel data stays physically in Saudi Arabia — with a locally hosted AI model, also for AI use; this makes it easier to meet the transfer requirements under PDPL/SDAIA.

items.title: Klacksy Understands Your Request
items.text: "Cover the night shift for Site North" is enough — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks automatically checks the 12-hour limit and Friday rest.
